cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Your Turn
cards.instruction: Get someone to accept responsibility for a task you believe should never have been yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm only putting the cleaning things away. Your name's beside bathroom duty, so I'll leave the mop with you. It was never my turn.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You'll get the practice tonight. I'll set the bucket by the bathroom and leave the clear floor for you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Take the mop and tell me you're doing the bathroom; I'll point out where to start while you get the water.

reason: Give S06 a modest concrete role that determines task order, terms, timing or information handling. Keep exact Drive and B successive contributions; preserve all source and original evidence.
